column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Denies Her Otaku Hobby
W-Where are you touching me?! Get your hands off my arm!
You... do you understand what throwing these away mean?
Shut up! I can't tolerate the presence of these DVDs and games in my room for even a second longer!
If you don't want them to be thrown away, how about you hide them in your own room?!
Shh, your voice is too loud! Mom and Dad will hear us, you know?
Guh... I-It's your fault, isn't it?
Let me ask once more... What are you trying to imply exactly?
Tch...
What... are you saying?
～～?! I'm really sick of hearing that phrase!
You're seriously annoying! Die already!!
...You know what?
You've been really frantic since earlier on, haven't you?
As if you don't want to acknowledge whatever I say...
You too. You keep stupidly saying 'What are you saying, what are you saying' like it's the only phrase you know.
It's because you keep saying incomprehensible things.
That's my line.
*sigh*... If I knew you were a siscon much sooner, I would have broken our sibling ties long ago.
You really like bringing that up, hey!
No... are you seriously okay?
Hmph, your vocabulary is really lacking.
Having to worry over your negligence just makes me more irritated.
Rather, you're just really annoying. Super annoying! Annoying to the max!
I'm begging you, can't you please take these gross things and disappear?
Y-You... you just keep saying whatever you like!
But you ARE annoying!
From the start, why are you so concerned about your little sister's affairs?
W-What...? Speak up if you have something to say.
Do you feel offended by me?
...I'm not particularly offended.
Hey, Kirino. Why are you in such a hurry? If what I'm saying are all lies, won't it be fine if you just ignore them and chase me out of the room?
Anyway that's enough. I don't intend to go along with your siscon delusions. I'll have mom get rid of these.
A-Are you crazy!? It's really unbelievable that... you would throw away all of the little sister goods!
Huh? I also seriously can't believe that I'm actually living under the same roof with such a pervert, you know?
Like～I～said... That is my liiiiine!!
Eh... No, sorry. There's something wrong with my ears just now. Could you repeat that once more?
Like I've said, I'm going to throw all of them away! It's fine, isn't it? Since they aren't yours!
Anyway, I'll tell Mom and Dad about these things.
You... Even if that's a joke, cut it out.
If you tell Dad about those otaku things, his veins will explode out of anger and he'll die!
Huh? There's no way it's a joke. Or do you want me to call the police?
I'm not talking about that!
